mapper.select: SELECT r.*, usk.kwd_no, usk.name AS keyword_name, usk.study_level FROM reservation r LEFT JOIN ( SELECT sk.*, ik.name FROM selected_keyword sk JOIN interest_keyword ik ON sk.kwd_no = ik.no ) AS usk ON usk.rsv_email = r.email WHERE r.email = #{email} AND password = #{password}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reservation (email, user_ip, password, name, phone, created_at) VALUES (#{email}, #{userIp}, #{password}, #{name}, #{phone}, now())
